duration.text: The Accounting at Henan University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3111 USD/per year ￥ 22400 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK HSK above Level 6 for Liberal Arts and above HSK 3 for Science. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Undergraduate school transcript Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From Vice-Professors or people with equal titles.

requirements.text: Below 40 years old; With Bachelor’s Degree; HSK above Level 6 for Arts.
